title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Talent – Winner ‘Seek Large Recruitment Agency of the Year’ 3 consecutive years! (ACT, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). An exciting opportunity exists for a Data Analyst specialising in the Oracle Utilities applications products. Start ASAP Canberra Based Contract role This role is required to: Design and Develop data scripting for the OUAF/Oracle ODI application. Work collaboratively with business and project stakeholders to guide data migration development. Support and co-ordinate data migration decision making between internal and external project staff. Develop and maintain data migration scripts and documentation. Participate in project sprint planning and closure activities. Support development of showcases for business stakeholders. Operate in a manner consistent with Icon Water values. The Successful candidate will have: Demonstrated Experience working in data migration, ETL processes, data cleansing and validation on large Oracle ERP programs. An accomplished Data Analyst with experience (2 years+) developing and implementing data migration solutions using the Oracle ODI product, (including demonstrated experience working within an asset intensive industry implementation project). Experience working with (or demonstrated understanding of) the Oracle Utility Application Framework. Experience in all stages of a product, platform or systems development lifecycle. Desired: Experience working within the Agile methodology and ability to participate within all Agile ceremonies. Experience working within a Water Utility. Demonstrated relationship with the Oracle OUAF Product Group to support the timely resolution of data design decisions, e.g. Business Object load decisions. To apply for this opportunity, please submit your application to Medha Malik at Talent International by clicking the "APPLY NOW' button below.
